description: CrossData - Regionalplanung - Verkehr is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Freistaat Sachsen. Es sind regionalplanerische Festlegungen des Komplexes Raumnutzung - Verkehr für die deutsch-tschechische grenzüberschreitende Zusammenarbeit der Planungsbehörden dargestellt. Der Datensatz enthält Daten der Planungsregionen Region Chemnitz, Oberes Elbtal-Osterzgebirge und Oberlausitz-Niederschlesien. Coverage: Freistaat Sachsen. The portal files it under the publisher Freistaat Sachsen. Its tags are asociace-regionlnho-plnovn, ausbau, bahntrasse, bundesland-freistaat-sachsen, bypass. It offers 1 resource(s) in APPLICATION/X-7Z-COMPRESSED. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
